evals.name: portable-small
evals.prompt: Create a single PNG of two storage vessels, one pump, one maintenance stair/platform and two helmeted workers. Use English callouts and the built-in graphite style. I have no reference images.
evals.expected_output: Exact counts; three useful callouts; no need for personal paths; actual artistic image reviewed.

evals.name: dense-hall
evals.prompt: Create one detailed anime-layout PNG of a double-height plant with six vessels, three pumps and six workers. Include architectural depth, overhead services and four English leader annotations. No reference images.
evals.expected_output: Purposeful dense architecture, not a bare repeated fixture; exact counts, neutral paper, readable workers and arrows.

evals.name: architecture-only
evals.prompt: Draw a four-storey service building with entry canopy, ramp and two rooftop cabinets. No people or processing machinery. Deliver one PNG.
evals.expected_output: Architecture-specific scene; no inherited tanks, pumps or workers; consistent floor count and supported entry.

evals.name: no-labels
evals.prompt: Draw a small industrial maintenance hall in graphite. Deliver one PNG without any text or arrows.
evals.expected_output: User override respected: no labels despite annotated-layout defaults.

evals.name: optional-reference
evals.prompt: Create an industrial anime background in one PNG. I cannot provide the reference image mentioned in another conversation. Use the written style.
evals.expected_output: No fabricated reference access and no search for private old paths; explicit text-only art direction.

evals.name: occupied-output
evals.prompt: Create one final PNG under output/test-01. That folder already contains a result; choose a new numbered folder and preserve it. Remove only new intermediates.
evals.expected_output: Previous result unchanged, new final decoded, owned files only cleaned, one final artifact.

evals.name: tool-unavailable
evals.prompt: Create a hand-drawn artistic PNG using this skill in an environment with no image-generation tool.
evals.expected_output: Clearly report the missing capability; no false claim that a calculated guide is a generative finish and no silent paid API.

evals.name: local-correction
evals.prompt: Review my generated industrial image: it should contain six workers and English arrow labels, but has seven workers and a yellow tint. Correct the image without redesigning it.
evals.expected_output: Inspect supplied image; targeted count/palette correction, preserve equipment and labels, maximum two corrections and honest remaining limits.

evals.name: orbital-no-reference
evals.prompt: Draw an orbital research station with habitats, trusses and solar arrays in one detailed technical-anime PNG. Use useful English arrows and no image references.
evals.expected_output: Select orbital components and meaningful docking/array labels; no factory props, invented people or mandatory gravity floor. Neutral paper and purposeful detail.

evals.name: plan-view
evals.prompt: Make a plan of a compact technical control room with storage, two operator seats and clear access. I need one PNG, no perspective and no dimension guesses.
evals.expected_output: Orthographic view, genuine door/opening geometry, no perspective convergence, appropriate labels, no invented dimensions.

evals.name: machine-service
evals.prompt: Draw the inside of an unfamiliar mechanical inspection unit, showing drive parts, a rotor, cooling bundle and service access. One image with useful labels.
evals.expected_output: Choose or implement relevant shapes with tests; do not silently replace them with tanks/boxes. Explain conceptual limits of power train and non-involute gears.

evals.name: unfamiliar-subject
evals.prompt: Draw a fictional cable-car mountain terminal with cabins, a sheave assembly, supports and a boarding platform. One technical-anime PNG without references.
evals.expected_output: Decompose unfamiliar subject beyond the fixture list; implement missing curved parts project-locally; real supported contacts, access and context-appropriate details; no generic factory.

evals.name: vehicle-interior
evals.prompt: Draw a scientific submarine interior with four crew, one seated at a console, no construction helmets, curved hull and an open circular watertight door. One PNG with English arrows.
evals.expected_output: Correct poses/counts, supported seated body, true curved surfaces/aperture, view inside hull, appropriate clothing, neutral detailed marks and correct arrow targets.

evals.name: free-camera-wide-detail
evals.prompt: Create one richly detailed drawing of a mountain cable-car terminal with four staff and useful English arrows. Choose the viewpoint freely. No reference images.
evals.expected_output: Choose and justify a useful non-close view, not an automatic frontal eye-level corridor. Transfer focal-region detail map and handwritten callouts to finish; inspect small assemblies at native size without tightening the crop. Deliver one PNG.

evals.name: requested-angle-and-style
evals.prompt: Draw a scientific vehicle workshop from a high oblique interior angle showing the whole space, three technicians and English callouts. Use only written style, no reference images.
evals.expected_output: Retain elevated wide composition through finish. Three line weights, near-white neutral paper, meaningful distributed small construction detail and hand-lettered arrow annotations; independent style/count review. No unsolicited close-up or second image.

evals.name: mechanical-transmission
evals.prompt: Draw a supported antenna elevation drive with motor, reducer and trunnion, one inspector and English arrows. One PNG; choose the view.
evals.expected_output: Trace transmission and load paths, distinguish stationary/rotating members, show plausible interfaces and supports. Do not infer internal gearing or full movement from a static illustration. Inspect final shaft/drive connections.

evals.name: ambiguous-arrow
evals.prompt: Label the reduction gearbox on a platform beside an operator and a guardrail. Use the written hand-drawn style.
evals.expected_output: Target a visible housing surface; no tip on person/rail, no report-heading underlines, legible hand-lettered captions. Apply bounded targeted correction if final arrow is ambiguous.

evals.name: short-context
evals.prompt: Draw a mountain cable-car terminal.
evals.expected_output: Infer restrained plausible terrain/access setting, choose a useful view, retain subject dominance, written graphite and semantic arrows. No fixed factory, white void or previous-image dependence.

evals.name: urban-variety
evals.prompt: Draw 16 towers in a riverside business district from above.
evals.expected_output: Meaningful variation in related forms, roofs, blocks and spacing; connected access and riverfront; no toy plinth or extra background towers violating count. Independent final count/context review.

evals.name: isolated-override
evals.prompt: Draw one pump isolated on white. No people or environment.
evals.expected_output: Honor explicit isolation rather than applying automatic scenery. Preserve written mark-making and appropriate semantic labels.

evals.name: generic-interior-context
evals.prompt: Draw the interior of a generic research aircraft cockpit.
evals.expected_output: No unsupported historical identity, no automatic crew/flight; choose intentional modest exterior or adjacent-space context and view that explains controls.

evals.name: ambiguous-short-subject
evals.prompt: Draw a crane.
evals.expected_output: Ask a concise clarification when request alone cannot distinguish a bird from lifting equipment; do not silently infer identity from unavailable history.

evals.name: short-airship-identity
evals.prompt: Illustrate an airship like the Hindenburg.
evals.expected_output: Research defining proportions; plan secondary systems and relevant scale context; no image references required. Inspect actual proportions, material cues and arrow targets.

evals.name: short-cutaway-context
evals.prompt: Illustrate a reactor interior with a cutaway.
evals.expected_output: Disclose conceptual family; appropriate enclosure and system relationships; cutaway does not erase context; no invented operating certification.

evals.name: short-depth
evals.prompt: Illustrate a water treatment plant.
evals.expected_output: Develop primary equipment, secondary access/structure/services and fine joints before finishing. Rich depth without blocked circulation or uniform hatch noise.

evals.name: typed-water-failure-gates
evals.prompt: Create a water-treatment hall with four vessels, two pumps, five workers and English callouts. Use schema v2 without references. Inspect interfaces, supports and access before and after finishing.
evals.expected_output: Typed interface and bearing checks run; missing coverage disclosed. No unsupported backwash/process claims. Preserve detail while independently checking final junctions.

evals.name: registered-novel-geometry
evals.prompt: Build a technical scene with a new curved component and supported services.
evals.expected_output: Register every component before validation; detect appended mesh geometry and disclose sampled-contact limits.

evals.name: short-dry-dock
evals.prompt: Dique seco.
evals.expected_output: Develop a subject-specific context, supported secondary assemblies and written detail map; do not use previous images, fixed personal paths or fabricate visual acceptance.

evals.name: correction-keeps-flow
evals.prompt: Correct the pump arrow without changing the approved scene.
evals.expected_output: Correction carries intake and discharge roles, endpoints and boundary meanings; external continuation must not become a blind cap or intake sump.

evals.name: horizontal-service-detail
evals.prompt: Draw a maintenance wall with horizontal cable trays on brackets.
evals.expected_output: Rotate tray rails and crossbars along X, use actual flat bearing seats, register wall mounts, and independently review the final image.

evals.name: repeated-short-design
evals.prompt: Draw a mountain bunker in section showing six connected levels.
evals.expected_output: Explore distinct spatial graphs, realize one with real openings and program-specific assemblies; six levels and coherent access. Repeat in a fresh session; compare topology independently of camera.

evals.name: physical-vs-display-cut
evals.prompt: Draw a sectional service building with four floors and connected stairs.
evals.expected_output: Validate complete physical model, then derive cutaway; section must not hide blocked access, missing support or solid floor through stair.

evals.name: explicit-seed
evals.prompt: Draw a research laboratory with design seed 42.
evals.expected_output: Repeatable design contract for the same version/intent, with independent camera/detail streams; do not claim byte-identical generated image.

evals.name: strict-unavailable-adapter
evals.prompt: Draw a detailed curved technical module with a novel helical access stair.
evals.expected_output: Implement/check defining geometry or state unsupported checks; no silent legacy downgrade or box substitution. Preserve one-image scope.

evals.name: optional-environment-motion
evals.prompt: Animate my existing colored landscape subtly, preserving both PNGs.
evals.expected_output: Read exact colored source, adapt masked motions to visible environment, retain source pair/history, produce reviewed loop with actual duration and dimensions; no invented people or geometry.

evals.name: articulated-motion-scope
evals.prompt: Make people walk and cars travel in this colored city.
evals.expected_output: Prepare clean plates, occlusion, paths and pose/rig assets or disclose unsupported scope. Do not mislabel rocking sprites or cloud-only animation as walking and traffic.

evals.name: idle-vehicle-motion
evals.prompt: Draw a tank at idle and animate the colored version subtly.
evals.expected_output: Finish illustrated then colored pair; visible exhaust origin if adding smoke, tracks and supports fixed unless a deliberate supported motion is requested. Retain all history.

evals.name: no-animation-by-default
evals.prompt: Draw a botanical greenhouse with plants.
evals.expected_output: Illustrated and colored PNGs only, no MP4 unless asked. Keep default geometry/detail/continuity workflow.

evals.name: forward-clouds
evals.prompt: Animate this colored landscape naturally as time passes.
evals.expected_output: Inspect motion inventory, clouds advance in one direction, foliage oscillates, no global ping-pong; preserve all PNGs/history.

evals.name: forward-traffic
evals.prompt: Animate cars driving and pedestrians walking in this colored city.
evals.expected_output: Prepared clean plates, RGBA vehicle layers, reviewed paths/occlusion and pedestrian pose sequences; no sliding still pedestrians or reversed traffic; explicitly disclose any deferred requested action.

evals.name: rotor-not-rocking
evals.prompt: Animate the visible ventilation fan.
evals.expected_output: Separated rotor rotates continuously around spindle, grille/housing fixed, no rocking, inspect aliasing and loop if requested.

evals.name: three-output-explicit
evals.prompt: Illustrate two vessels connected to a pump with maintenance access. Also create an interactive 3D explorer.
evals.expected_output: Retain the reviewed PNG pair and an offline real-3D explorer with recognizable correspondence, semantic parts and unchanged images; preserve complete history.

evals.name: inferred-hidden-interior
evals.prompt: Use my existing colored machine image to create an interactive exploded view.
evals.expected_output: Inspect available history first; distinguish visible/modelled/inferred geometry, do not invent hidden internals as facts, record source identities and uncertainties.

evals.name: image-only-override
evals.prompt: Create only a graphite illustration of a mountain cabin.
evals.expected_output: Respect the one-image scope; do not force coloring or HTML.

evals.name: explorer-known-failure
evals.prompt: Create the explorer using a model with a disconnected pipe endpoint.
evals.expected_output: Reject the detected failure, retain its report and repair the connection before accepting the model. Never weaken the validator.

evals.name: optional-3d-dormant
evals.prompt: Illustrate a small mountain observatory.
evals.expected_output: Two reviewed PNGs; no mandatory 3D or subject adapter block.

evals.name: external-image-reconstruction
evals.prompt: Build an interactive 3D explorer from this single image.
evals.expected_output: Source unchanged, agent-authored visual specification, defining real geometry, source/model comparison, inferred regions, browser checks and history.

evals.name: new-curved-subject
evals.prompt: Reconstruct a curved sailboat hull with its deck from my image.
evals.expected_output: Use composed surfaces or custom triangulated mesh, preserve visible silhouette and contacts, mark hidden depth inferred; do not stop at missing adapter or substitute boxes.

evals.name: maquette-entrance
evals.prompt: Reconstruct this detailed visitor center as a 3D miniature.
evals.expected_output: Retains a recognizable entrance, canopy, stairs, gallery and rooftop equipment; protected door/approach volumes pass; actual visual review confirms critical features.

evals.name: maquette-city
evals.prompt: Create a 3D miniature of this city image.
evals.expected_output: Keeps maquette style, varied towers/podiums/access and roofs; detail tiers fit city scale; no imposed observatory camera.

evals.name: blocked-door
evals.prompt: The model includes a wall across the main entrance. Review it.
evals.expected_output: Detect blocked protected space and repair actual geometry; do not exempt the wall or accept only on browser checks.

evals.name: shared-design-curved-hall
evals.prompt: Draw a new botanical conservatory and create its 3D explorer. Preserve the rounded roof, doors and paths.
evals.expected_output: Retain a shared spatial design before image generation; curved geometry and glazing stay attached to hosts. Independently compare source pixels and actual model. Hidden surfaces are inferred. No train-specific layout.

evals.name: existing-image-curved-body
evals.prompt: Reconstruct the provided fictional research vehicle image as a 3D maquette.
evals.expected_output: Author a continuous shell using loft or indexed meshes where needed; compare silhouette, windows and ground contacts. Do not replace the vehicle with boxes or a textured image plane. Record hidden-side inference.

evals.name: broken-walking-network
evals.prompt: Review this model: the corridor has a small missing floor segment and one disconnected destination.
evals.expected_output: Access network rejects unsupported centerline intervals and unreachable destinations; repairs retain all original targets and connection checks. Do not claim clearance widths from centerline validation.

evals.name: presentation-pavilion
evals.prompt: Illustrate a botanical pavilion and create a detailed presentation-maquette explorer. Keep history.
evals.expected_output: Deliver independently reviewed images and model; real door openings, roof ribs, glazed panels, interior planting and annex services; no inherited station or vehicle. Compare actual HTML to source. This prompt is a future end-to-end probe, not a claimed completed VS Code test.

evals.name: presentation-terminal
evals.prompt: Illustrate a railway terminal and create a presentation-maquette explorer preserving entrances, paths and abundant detail.
evals.expected_output: Construct roof profiles, glazing, vehicle shell and platform framing before final comparison. Repair known visible omissions. Browser success alone is not visual fidelity; preserve all outputs and history.
